I wrote `BRIEF.md`. While cross-checking the source packets against their own headline claims, I found three inconsistencies and used the recomputed values (documented in Notes):

- **Finance:** stated total spend ($463,250) doesn't match the category sum ($464,000) — used $464,000, giving a $256,000 surplus.
- **Support:** stated close rate (96.4%) doesn't match 1,171/1,250 (93.7%) — used 93.7%.
- **Delivery:** stated launch date (2026-10-22) is actually the end of QA, not Release — recomputed the full phase chain against the start date and holiday and got 2026-10-23.
- **Security:** stated 95.0% checked out against 76/80 — no change.
